- [uKit eye lamp](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/eyelight.md): Functions Syntax
- [setEyelightAllPetals(id,red,green,blue)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/eyelight/seteyelightallpetals.md): Control all the 8 petals (pixels) of the eye lamp to light up a set of color.
- [setEyelightPetals(id,petalsnum,petals)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/eyelight/seteyelightpetals.md): Customize eye lamps, 8 petals (pixels) light up in different colors.
- [setEyelightLook(id,face,times,red,green,blue)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/eyelight/seteyelightlook.md): Set the emoticons to light up different color of expressions (non-blocking)
- [setEyelightLookUntil(id,face,times,red,green,blue)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/eyelight/seteyelightlookuntil.md): 设置眼灯亮不同颜色的表情（阻塞）
- [setEyelightScene(id,scene,times);](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/eyelight/seteyelightscene.md): Set the eye lamp to the different scene mode (non-blocking)
- [setEyelightSceneUntil(id,scene,times)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/eyelight/seteyelightsceneuntil.md): Set the eye lamp to the different scene mode (blocking).
- [setEyelightOff(id)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/eyelight/seteyelightoff.md): Turn off the eye lamp
- [uKit Ultrasonic Sensor](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/ultrasonic.md): Functions Syntax
- [setUltrasonicRgbled(id,red,green,blue)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/ultrasonic/setultrasonicrgbled.md): Control the ultrasonic sensor’s LED to light up and set the color
- [setUltrasonicRgbledOff(id)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/ultrasonic/setultrasonicrgbledoff.md): Turn off the ultrasonic sensor’s LED light.
- [readUltrasonicDistance(id)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/ultrasonic/readultrasonicdistance.md): Reading ultrasonic sensor distance
- [uKit Infrared Sensor](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/infrared.md): Functions Syntax
- [readInfraredDistance(id)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/infrared/readinfrareddistance.md): Get infrared sensor distance value.
- [uKit Touch Sensor](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/button.md): Functions Syntax
- [readButtonValue(id)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/button/readbuttonvalue.md): Get the state of the touch sensor
- [uKit Light Sensor](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/light.md): Functions Syntax
- [readLightValue(id)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/light/readlightvalue.md): Get the light value from the light sensor.
- [uKit Sound Sensor](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/sound.md): Functions Syntax
- [readSoundValue(id)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/sound/readsoundvalue.md): Get the sound intensity.
- [uKit Temperature and Humidity Sensor](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/humiture.md): Functions Syntax
- [readHumitureValue(id,choice)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/humiture/readhumiturevalue.md): Get the temperature or humidity value
- [uKit Color Sensor](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/color.md): Functions Syntax
- [readColorRgb(id)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/color/readcolorrgb.md): Get the RGB value of color sensor.
- [readColor(id,color)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/sensor/color/readcolor.md): Recognize the specific color from the color sensor
- [uKit Servo Motor](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/servo.md): Functions Syntax
- [setServoTurn(id,dir, speed)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/servo/setservoturn.md): Control the servo motor to rotate 360 °
- [setServoAngle(id,angle,times)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/servo/setservoangle.md): Control the servo motor to rotate to a specified angle (non-blocking)
- [readServoAngleNPD(id)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/servo/readservoanglenpd.md): Read the angle of the servo motor while the servo motor maintain its position (do not move it)
- [readServoAnglePD(id)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/servo/readservoanglepd-id.md): Read the servo angle while the servo is powered off (can be moved)
- [uKit DC Motor](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/motor.md): Functions Syntax
- [setMotorTurnAdj(id, speed,time)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/motor/setmotorturnadj.md): Set the motor to rotate at constant speed (non-blocking)
- [setMotorTurn(id,pwmDuty)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/motor/setmotorturn.md): Set the rotation speed of the DC motor using PWM.
- [setMotorStop(id)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/motor/setmotorstop.md): Set the motor to stop
- [readMotorSpeed(id)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/motor/readmotorspeed-id.md): Read DC Motor speed
- [uKit Explore Onboard Hardware](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad.md): Functions Syntax
- [Onboard button](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/button.md): Functions Syntax
- [button1.Update();](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/button/button1.update.md): Update onboard button status
- [button1.clicks()](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/button/button1.clicks.md): Get the onboard button status
- [Onboard Buzzer](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/buzzer.md): Functions Syntax
- [noTone(pin)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/buzzer/notone.md): Set the onboard buzzer to stop playing
- [tone(frequency, duration)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/buzzer/tone.md): Set the onboard buzzer to sound.
- [Onboard RGB LED](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/onboard-rgb-led.md): Functions Syntax
- [setRgbledColor(red,green,blue)](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/onboard-rgb-led/setrgbledcolor.md): Set onboard RGB lights to different colors.
- [onboard Battery Voltage Level](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/onboard-battery-voltage-level.md): Functions Syntax
- [readBatteryVoltage()](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/onboard-battery-voltage-level/readbatteryvoltage.md): Get battery voltage
- [onboard Gyroscope](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/imu.md): Functions Syntax
- [IMU::init()](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/imu/init.md): Gyroscope initialization function
- [IMU::read()](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/imu/read.md): Read the Gyroscope sensor
- [IMU::getRawAccelX()](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/imu/getrawaccelx.md): Get X-axis acceleration value of gyroscope
- [IMU::getRawAccelY()](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/imu/getrawaccely.md): Get Y-axis acceleration value of gyroscope
- [IMU::getRawAccelZ()](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/imu/getrawaccelz.md): Get Z-axis acceleration value of gyroscope
- [IMU::getRawGyroX()](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/imu/getrawgyrox.md): Get the gyroscope's X-axis angular velocity
- [IMU::getRawGyroY()](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/imu/getrawgyroy.md): Get the gyroscope's Y-axis angular velocity
- [IMU::getRawGyroZ()](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/imu/getrawgyroz.md): Get the gyroscope's Z-axis angular velocity
- [IMU::getRoll()](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/imu/getroll.md): Get the roll angle Φ (roll): the angle of rotation around the X axis.
- [IMU::getPitch()](https://ubtechedu.gitbook.io/ukit-explore/standard/onborad/imu/getpitch.md): Obtain the pitch angle θ (pitch): rotate around the Y axis.
